arguments.sql:
SELECT s.publisher_id, r.race, COUNT(*) AS characters
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
WHERE s.publisher_id IN (
    SELECT a.publisher_id FROM superhero AS a WHERE a.superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
GROUP BY s.publisher_id, r.race
ORDER BY r.race
